fields.title: 📖 Even in judgment the servant needs Istighfār
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah commands the Prophet ﷺ in the context of judging: Ask Allah for forgiveness; Allah is All-Forgiving and Merciful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This shows humility in the Ḥukm: the servant does not judge arrogantly, but with fear, examination, and return to Allah.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:106.
